args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Vacation (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen
- Hiking gear
- Casual outfits
- Camera
- Travel documents

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Reef-safe sunscreen (required for some beaches)
- Water shoes for snorkeling
- Light rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Comfortable walking shoes for hiking
- Evening attire for the luau
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkel gear (optional, can be rented)
- Waterproof phone case
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Medications
- Power adapter/charger
- Cash and credit cards
- Hotel reservation confirmation
- Flight information
